en: Sepia-toned street scene of a European town square or courtyard with bare winter trees and multi-story historic buildings. A central building with three large arched passageways at ground level and rows of arched windows above forms a gateway onto another street. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing stand near posters and shopfronts. In the lower right corner there is a printed decorative element: a heraldic lion with a crown standing beside a shield containing a portrait of an elderly, bearded man in a decorated military uniform, likely an Austro‑Hungarian imperial figure.
